title: login
summary: MSUI realizes the current desktop AccountLogin glue: the UI_MainMenu burning-gate scene rendered through the model's authored camera/fog/light rig, AccountLogin edit fields, Remember Account Name, and rule-owned host/tuning windows and 512-wide GlueDialogs. Connection progress uses the current Connecting / Authenticating / Handshaking / Entering World captions and a 200x40 Cancel; login refusals and lost-session failures now block the account screen with a wrapped Okay dialog dismissible by Okay, Escape or Enter instead of appearing as an inline red status. A refused password still cleanly resets the worker so a corrected submit works. Benilla's login/smoke.rs is CI-only screenshot/probe instrumentation and has no player-facing desktop behavior to port.

openItems.text: Current Benilla presents login refusals and session failures as a blocking, centered GlueDialog; MSUI displayed the raw failure inline beneath Login and kept the underlying account controls active.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: LoginUiLaw now owns the content-sized 512-wide dialog, 440-wide message seat and centered 200x40 button. Failure text is cleaned and wrapped, underlying controls are blocked, and Okay/Escape/Enter dismiss; progress uses the same current law with Cancel. Focused and full suites pass.

openItems.text: MSUI's login host, tuning window and desktop-only Launch Options overlay retained authored window/modal geometry in ImGui renderers.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: LoginUiLaw now owns the full-screen account/connecting hosts, 380-wide tuning window and complete established 420x250 Launch Options layout. Renderers only host the law-resolved rectangles, and the focused login check pins both values and ownership. Presentation and behavior are unchanged.
